_source: Copied from growth/keywords.json (findability keyword inventory) on 2026-10-09. Only the tool name and keyword-first summary per route; no other fields.

/v1/id/iban.summary: IBAN validator: length, mod-97 check digits, bank/branch/account breakdown (89 countries)

/v1/id/iban-build.summary: IBAN generator: build an IBAN from country and BBAN or bank/branch/account, computing check digits

/v1/id/national.summary: VAT, tax ID and national ID validator: 23 countries, checksum only (VAT formats BE, DE, FR, IT, PL, AT, CH, IE)

/v1/id/security.summary: ISIN validator plus CUSIP, SEDOL and FIGI check-digit validation; builds an ISIN from an NSIN

/v1/id/gs1.summary: GTIN barcode validator: EAN-13, UPC-A (GTIN-12), GTIN-8/14, GLN and SSCC check digits

/v1/time/zone.summary: Timezone converter: instant to local time in an IANA time zone and back, with UTC offset and DST state

/v1/time/dst.summary: DST transitions: next daylight-saving time changes for an IANA time zone

/v1/time/business-days.summary: Business days calculator: add or count working days with your weekend mask and holiday list

/v1/time/rrule.summary: RRULE expander: RFC 5545 recurrence rule to concrete occurrence dates

/v1/time/calendar.summary: Calendar converter: Gregorian to Hijri, Hebrew, Japanese era, Persian and more, plus Easter date

/v1/text/similarity.summary: String similarity: Levenshtein, Jaro-Winkler distance and Soundex/Metaphone phonetic keys

/v1/text/slug.summary: Slug generator: Unicode-aware URL slug with transliteration

/v1/text/transliterate.summary: Cyrillic transliteration to Latin (ISO 9:1995, BGN/PCGN Russian)

/v1/text/unicode.summary: Unicode normalization (NFC/NFKC), script detection and homoglyph/confusable check

/v1/code/hash.summary: Hash generator: SHA-256, SHA-512, SHA-3, Keccak-256, BLAKE2 and HMAC digests

/v1/code/idn.summary: Punycode converter: IDN domain to ASCII and back, with IDNA2008 label validation

/v1/code/jwt.summary: JWT decoder: header, claims and expiry state (no signature verification)

/v1/code/semver.summary: Semver parser: parse and compare versions, check range satisfaction

/v1/code/url.summary: URL parser: parse, canonicalize and extract the registrable domain (eTLD+1)

/v1/geo/geohash.summary: Geohash encoder and decoder with neighbour cells

/v1/geo/pluscode.summary: Plus code (Open Location Code) encoder and decoder

/v1/geo/polygon.summary: Point in polygon check, plus bounding box, centroid and area for GeoJSON

/v1/geo/distance.summary: Distance calculator: geodesic distance, bearing and destination point on WGS-84

/v1/chain/address.summary: Crypto address validator: detect the blockchain and verify the checksum (EVM, Bitcoin, Solana and more)

/v1/chain/selector.summary: Solidity function selector: Keccak-256, 4-byte selector and event topic from a signature

/v1/ref/airport.summary: Airport lookup by IATA or ICAO code: name, coordinates, elevation, time zone; nearest airports

/v1/ref/country.summary: Country lookup: ISO 3166 codes, currency, TLD, UN region and ISO 3166-2 subdivisions

/v1/ref/currency.summary: Currency lookup: ISO 4217 codes, names, minor units and cash rounding

/v1/ref/nuts.summary: NUTS region lookup: EU statistical region codes, names and hierarchy

/v1/num/allocate.summary: Money split: allocate an amount into shares with no rounding loss

/v1/num/radix.summary: Base converter: integers between number bases 2 to 36 (hex, binary, octal)

/v1/num/stats.summary: Statistics calculator: mean, median, standard deviation, quartiles and percentiles

/v1/num/words.summary: Number to words in 12 languages, with ordinal and currency forms
